verdict.rationale: Built-in AI assistance is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes Ubuntu as a platform for running third-party AI/ML software and tooling. Nothing shows the product itself generating insights or suggestions from user data; HUD and Dash search are menu and app search, not AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
